newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica's Cosatu to hold half day strike on May 12.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica's Cosatu to hold half day strike on May 12.

text.p: South Africa's largest trade union federation the Congress of South African Trade Unions (Cosatu) said on Friday that it planned to go ahead with a half day of national action on May 12.
"There will be action on May 12...it will take the form of marches and rallies to employers associations, beginning at noon on that day," Cosatu general secretary Sam Shilowa told a news briefing.
Shilowa said workers would be expected to go to work as normal in the morning.
Cosatu has mobilised its members to strike over a controversial new employment bill which was approved by the South African cabinet on Wednesday.

The Basic Conditions of Employment Bill, which will go for discussion to the statutory National Economic Development and Labour Council (Nedlac) in the next few weeks, has threatened to become a flashpoint between trade unions and business.
Industry leaders fear the new legislation will hike their costs while labour is concerned that proposals designed to protect workers may be watered down to meet employer concerns.
